script: This shot actually counts for 30 points! And it's because Jesser taped 10 basketballs together. However, this TikToker would see it and decided to break the world record with a 33 point shot! Well, this ended up starting a war between the two of them. So Jesser created the 100 point shot using multiple rims instead and only using five balls. But immediately, Bodlefty set a new record of 126 points. Of course, it wouldn't stop there as Jesser made the 150 point shot! Bodlefty would answer back and people thought this would be the last shot as he scored 216 points. Until months later, Jesser released this video where he scored 1,000 points in one shot.
retention_tricks: rapid escalation of numbers and stakes
what_makes_it_work: Escalating stakes that grow from 30 points all the way to 1,000 points.
Back-and-forth rivalry structure between creators creating direct competition.
Fast editing pace matched with energetic voiceover and on-screen counters.
